response.rationale: Both answers are valid for the stated light-related sense. Indonesian terang directly covers bright/illuminated and Malaysian cerah covers terang for days, lamps, skies, and similar contexts. The words overlap across both varieties, so similar is the correct relation; there is no false-friend contrast to add. Malaysian terang is also valid, making the national preference context-dependent but not incorrect.
